title: ComparisonRecord
description: Semantic comparison of a baseline profile's DecisionRecord against a candidate profile's DecisionRecord over the same ReplayBundle/ChangeSet (P3-E4-S03 / ADR-0018). Every difference is classified into exactly one member of the closed delta taxonomy — there is no "other"/free-text kind; a difference matching none of the six is a hard classification error (fail-closed, never silently dropped). A wording-only change to a rule's message template (no predicate/effect/phase/obligation change) MUST classify as explanation-only so rendered-message changes never enter semantic promotion gates (ADR-0014 amendment split). Top-level additionalProperties are allowed (ADR-0017 §9 additive-tolerant reports); nested delta shapes stay closed.

baselineProfile.description: Baseline PolicyProfile identity (name and/or revision), e.g. "prod-strict@6".

candidateProfile.description: Candidate PolicyProfile identity under comparison, e.g. "prod-strict@7".

caseId.description: Stable PolicyComparisonSuite caseId this record was produced for.

deltas.description: Named collection of classified differences. Empty when baseline and candidate agree on every semantic outcome. Per-delta identity is the (kind, rule, subject) triple — optional obligation further qualifies obligation-proving rules.

deltaKind.description: Closed six-member delta taxonomy (P3-E4-S03). No open string / "other". Fail-closed: classification that matches none of these six is a hard error for assent compare. explanation-only covers wording-only message-template changes and any other non-semantic presentation drift — never a promotion-gate failure by itself.

outcomeSide.description: Baseline or candidate outcome slice for the identified rule/subject. present=false means the side produced no finding/decision contribution for that identity.

effect.description: Finding effect when a finding is present on this side.

present.description: Whether this side contributed a finding/outcome for the delta identity.

delta.description: One classified difference. Identity fields (rule, optional obligation, subject) plus baseline vs candidate outcome sides — the per-delta identity used by acceptedDeltas allowlists (never kind alone).

rule.description: MergePolicy rule name the delta concerns (identity).

obligation.description: Present when the delta concerns an obligation-proving rule; absent otherwise (identity).
